title: OptionButton dropdown is affected by WorldEnvironment despite being in another CanvasLayer
body: ### Tested versions - Tested in 4.5.1 Stable, 4.4.1 Stable ### System information Linux Mint 22.1 - Forward+, Mobile and Compatibility ### Issue description Documentation says that WorldEnvironment/Background mode/Canvas should limit effects to Canvas Max Layer and adding another CanvasLayer with value greater Max Layer should be unaffected, the OptionButton itself works as intended but its drop-down list still receives postprocessing effects, all 3 backends affected (Forward+ , Mobile and Compatibility). Example in my project dropdowns ### Steps to reproduce Minimal reproduction project, just run and compare OptionButton. Root Control node with OptionButton with some items added for the dropdown list. WorldEnvironment node: Background mode = Canvas Mode Canvas Max Layer = 0 Enabled Glow and Adjustments, either or both are visible for the bug. CanvasLayer node: Layer value > 0, default 1 works too. Another Option button with some items added for the dropdown list. The OptionButton itself (and most other Control nodes) work as intended being excluded from WorldEnvironment effects per Max Layer value, but dropdown list is affected by the postprocessing effects. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [optionbutton_affected_by_worldenvironment.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24626029/optionbutton_affected_by_worldenvironment.zip)
